drhp.business: IIFL Finance Limited is a retail-focused non-banking financial institution delivering technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved and emerging segments. Its offerings span gold loans, home loans, MSME financing, and microfinance, distributed through a phygital network of ~4,800 branches and digital channels. The company operates alongside its material subsidiaries, IIFL Home Finance and IIFL Samasta Finance, to deepen reach in affordable housing and rural microfinance.

sk.overview: India's digital financial services and NBFC-led retail lending sector serves a large, young, credit-underpenetrated mass market. Formalization (GST, JAM/India Stack, eKYC), rising smartphone/internet penetration and low data costs are enabling tech-led NBFCs and fintechs to underwrite and serve borrowers that conventional banks have historically underserved, particularly in unsecured personal loans and loan-against-property.
